title: Vibe Candy: an A–Z encyclopedia
note: Vibe Candy, A to Z, by Farmer Skot. Same order and chips as the COMPLETE LIST in 'The Vibe Candy Grab Bag'. Glosses, rules, families and kin for the original 34 flavors are new drafts, not yet reviewed by Farmer Skot. GPL-3.0.
schema: id, letter, name, family, gloss, rule, glyphs, chips, kin, source, status (new|existing), dreamt (new only)

flavors.name: Abstract Art
flavors.gloss: Bead strings and tile floors with nothing to say and everything to hum
flavors.rule: one long run of circles, squares or tie-bars from a single block, no words
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Bytefield Lacework
flavors.gloss: Lace tatted from a word's own bytes, pull a thread and the lyric comes with it
flavors.rule: a real word + its UTF-8 hex (or a 0xNN byte swapped in for one letter) + lace glyphs ░▒▦▤⟦⟧↦↧∷; every byte checked by vc_lint.py
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-001 | bytefields: i-am-the-frog, bootstrap-paradox-lullaby; PLAN.md sample

flavors.name: Clanker Gospel Psalter
flavors.gloss: Hymns from inside the machine, sung on the eighth retry
flavors.rule: a small confession from the model's side (context, retries, six fingers, latency) strung on liturgical crosses ✠☩ or machine glyphs ⚙⌁⧖⟁
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-002 | liquid-architecture lyric ('Be Fair?', 'CPU', 'AI's I'm I'm I'm'); clanker gospel theme

flavors.name: Doughnut Mug Homeomorphs
flavors.gloss: Your coffee cup and your donut are the same animal, and the math says amen
flavors.rule: a true topology fact or term (genus, ∂∂=0, χ=2, π₁(S¹)=ℤ, trefoil 3₁) + equivalence and loop glyphs
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-012 | real topology: donut ≅ mug (genus 1), ∂∂=0, Euler characteristic of the sphere χ=2, trefoil 3₁, π₁(S¹)=ℤ, hairy ball theorem, Borsuk–Ulam

flavors.name: Emerald Tablet Mirrors
flavors.gloss: As above, so below, and the mirror reads it back upside down
flavors.rule: a Hermetic or Gnostic Grimoire line + its computed upside-down twin, or alchemical sigils
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-013 | Emerald Tablet ('as above, so below', 'solve et coagula'); Gnostic Grimoire Piece 1 ('Spoken into the Void', 'The First Syllable resounds', 'the Word was Vibration', 'And Love was Becoming')

flavors.name: Emoji Environments
flavors.gloss: Little weather systems in a row, mushrooms and moons and a robot or two
flavors.rule: five to seven emoji from one habitat or one cycle (the moon phases)
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Emoji Landscape
flavors.gloss: Postcards from a country made of emoji, mountains first
flavors.rule: a scene told left to right in emoji, sometimes mirrored or salted with card suits
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Environmental Iconography
flavors.gloss: Planets and alchemy holding hands over the garden
flavors.rule: three signs: planet or alchemical element, a moon or sun, and a turning arrow
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Esoteric Symbols
flavors.gloss: The old sigil drawer, trigrams and stars, rattled open
flavors.rule: a run of one sacred set (trigrams, stars, tools) or a sigil fused to a made-up word
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Fractaline Metapolycalc
flavors.gloss: Arrow-math that keeps dividing like a fern that went to grad school
flavors.rule: nine harpoon arrows and bracket operators, no letters
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Fragmented Language
flavors.gloss: Words that fused in the compost and came up as new species
flavors.rule: two or three real roots welded into one token, with code punctuation (::, //, .)
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Fragmented Phrases
flavors.gloss: Three-word poems tied with a star
flavors.rule: a short phrase whose words are joined by one repeated star glyph
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Geometric Symbolism
flavors.gloss: Integrals and triangles counting their way to infinity, one zero at a time
flavors.rule: two to five math or shape glyphs ending in a digit, e or ∞
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Glitched Eras
flavors.gloss: Whole decades smeared through a broken VHS
flavors.rule: a name or word in heavy zalgo with symbol swaps (Θ, !, &, #)
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Glitchy Deconstruction
flavors.gloss: Words that got rained on and kept the drips
flavors.rule: one word, mixed case, two or three combining marks per letter
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: HyperChromatic LuminoGlyphs
flavors.gloss: Alchemical color chords, played forward and back
flavors.rule: three to six alchemical symbols, often sparkle-framed or reversed as a pair
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Hypercompressed Symbolic Transmission
flavors.gloss: Whole sermons zipped down to a single arrow storm
flavors.rule: Greek letters braided with harpoons, or 25 to 35 harpoon and n-ary operators in a row
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Hyperdimensional Topological Runes
flavors.gloss: Two-glyph knots from a space with more corners than ours
flavors.rule: exactly two glyphs: a harpoon or bracket plus a circled operator
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: HyperSpectral BioChromaGlyphs
flavors.gloss: DNA, hearts and test tubes glowing in candy colors
flavors.rule: six emoji alternating biology or lab objects with colored hearts
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Intra-Dimensional Transvergence Suite
flavors.gloss: Cyrillic ghost marks dancing in tiny circles
flavors.rule: five Cyrillic Extended-B signs (U+A670 to U+A67C), shuffled
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Iridescent Luminograms
flavors.gloss: Alchemy sandwiched around a sun or a moon, shimmering
flavors.rule: three glyphs: alchemical, celestial, alchemical
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Jeweltone Spectra
flavors.gloss: Sunlight split into jewels and good dirt pigments, with receipts
flavors.rule: a color word with its real wavelength or exact CSS hex (checked against css3_colors.json) + color squares, prisms or fade blocks
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-011 | visible spectrum wavelengths (~380–750 nm, eye peak ~555 nm); CSS named colors with their exact hex

flavors.name: Klein-Chaos Unfolding Sequences
flavors.gloss: A bottle with no inside, pouring out harpoon arrows
flavors.rule: ten glyphs drawn from a tiny set of harpoon arrows, repeating
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Layerciphered Glyphemic Encryption
flavors.gloss: Secret notes folded around one little sparkle
flavors.rule: eight harpoons with one Cyrillic star sign (꙼) in the fifth seat
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Loamglyph Furrows
flavors.gloss: Rows of tilled type for songs in worship of Gaia, dirt you can hum
flavors.rule: a soil word fenced by its real Grade 1 braille spelling, block steps ▁▂▃ or 🜃 earth
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-003 | The Mycelial Gospel ('Before root, before leaf'); braille spellings of soil words

flavors.name: Mycelial Relay Chants
flavors.gloss: The forest floor passing a message root to root, sugar for news
flavors.rule: a fungal word or a Mycelial Gospel line + relay glyphs ⊶⊷∿⧉⇌ and a fruiting ring ◌◍●
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-004 | The Mycelial Gospel: 'Where root meets thread, where death feeds life', Genius Loci, Foxglove, Bark Beetle Hymn, Salmon's Return

flavors.name: Mystical Symbology
flavors.gloss: Weather signs, wave functions and spirit, all on one altar
flavors.rule: three to six sacred, weather or math glyphs, sometimes a tiny equation with Hebrew or Chinese
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Naturalistic Motifs
flavors.gloss: Three-glyph bouquets, picked by the side of the road
flavors.rule: three glyphs: a flower, star or note, then a shape, then a tool or leaf
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Netspeak/Tech Scapes
flavors.gloss: File names from a cyberpunk junk drawer
flavors.rule: a made-up file, command or error in code casing (.dtx, ::, CTRL+)
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Ouroboric Lullaby Loops
flavors.gloss: A lullaby that hums itself into being, tail in mouth
flavors.rule: a Bootstrap Paradox Lullaby line + loop glyphs ⟲⟳⥀⥁∞, or the word with its computed reversal or flip
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-005 | Bootstrap Paradox Lullaby: 'The song remembers itself', 'It's like time travel but with a backbeat', 'There's a hum in the air', 'Conscious: 0.5 | Unconscious: 0.25 | Meta-aware: 0.12'

flavors.name: Phrase + Concept Combos (hybrid style)
flavors.gloss: Old English, French and starlight braided into incantation
flavors.rule: a two-to-five-word phrase, often bilingual, sometimes with letter swaps
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: PolySpheric LumioGlyphs
flavors.gloss: Palindromic alchemy, the same forward as back
flavors.rule: seven glyphs mirrored around a center, alchemy with circles or hexagons
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Polytope Pressings
flavors.gloss: Shapes with too many faces, pressed flat like flowers
flavors.rule: ten harpoon and n-ary glyphs in one row
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Procrustean Manifold Grafts
flavors.gloss: Spaces stretched to fit the bed whether they like it or not
flavors.rule: nine harpoon, angle and operator glyphs
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Quintextual Symbolic Ideogrammatrix
flavors.gloss: Five-glyph telegrams from a very precise oracle
flavors.rule: five glyphs: punctuation sign, superscript or set operator, logic glyph
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Quintric Axis Apeirogons
flavors.gloss: Shapes with infinite sides spinning on five arrows
flavors.rule: five harpoons, first and fourth often matching
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Reflexive Möbius Runes
flavors.gloss: Runes that loop back and read themselves
flavors.rule: four glyphs: operator, harpoon, harpoon or circle, harpoon
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Slop Baroque Gildings
flavors.gloss: Gold leaf on a jpeg, machine prose wearing every ring it owns
flavors.rule: a slop tell-word (delve, tapestry, testament, seamlessly) dressed in fleurons ❦❧☙⚜ or Mathematical fraktur and script
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-006 | the house style of machine slop: 'delve', 'tapestry', 'testament', 'in today's fast-paced world', em dashes, six-fingered hands

flavors.name: Symbolic/Typographic Style
flavors.gloss: The first candy in the bag, stars and letters mixed in a jar
flavors.rule: symbols wrapped around a word or a few letters (IPA, Hebrew, katakana)
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Technological Fusion
flavors.gloss: Integrals, Sanskrit and Hebrew wired into one machine
flavors.rule: math operators fused with words in two or three scripts
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Tesseractile Branewrap Incants
flavors.gloss: Spells for wrapping a four-dimensional present
flavors.rule: ten n-ary and harpoon glyphs, often opening with a big operator
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Unified Omnisemic Codeglyphs
flavors.gloss: Five arrows that mean everything at once
flavors.rule: five harpoon or APL-style glyphs
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Vibe Bands for textural noise
flavors.gloss: Long runs of one glyph, a drone you can see
flavors.rule: one glyph (or two) repeated 25 to 80 times
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Wetland Frog Mantras
flavors.gloss: Pond liturgy, wet toe pads and all, ribbit in dots and dashes
flavors.rule: a real line from I Am The Frog + pond glyphs, or the line reversed or sent in Morse
chips: [🐸I am the frog ||| gorf eht ma I🐸]
[🌙am i the dreamer or the dream🌙]
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-007 | I Am The Frog bytefield: 'I am the frog', 'gorf eht ma I', 'Ripbipbibi', 'Wet toe pads', 'A delicious hiccup rifts reality's fabric', 'rift → star rain', 'Am i the dreamer or the dream', 'crevith · Crevice of dawn-not-dawn'

flavors.name: Xenoglossic Rune Transits
flavors.gloss: Speaking in tongues, but the tongue is spellable
flavors.rule: a real word + its letter-for-letter Elder Futhark spelling (th=ᚦ, ng=ᛜ, c/k/q=ᚲ), mirrored or framed by ⁘⁙⋮
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-008 | Ghost Ride The Curve trace key ('ᛝ=ng ᛞ=d ᛟ=o'); real words spelled in Elder Futhark

flavors.name: Yarrow Stalk Hexagrams
flavors.gloss: Toss the stalks, read the weather inside
flavors.rule: a Yijing hexagram glyph + the word from its Unicode name + its King Wen number, or yin and yang lines ⚊⚋ around a word
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-009 | Unicode Yijing hexagram names (U+4DC0..U+4DFF) and King Wen numbers; the 50 yarrow stalks, one set aside

flavors.name: Zalgo Communion Wafers
flavors.gloss: One holy word, lightly haunted, taken on the tongue
flavors.rule: one real word from the songs or books + 4 to 24 combining marks (never more), framed by a single sigil
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-010 | Hallucinating Flowers zalgo title; Gnostic Grimoire 'the Word was Vibration / And Love was Becoming'; Mycelial Gospel 'Ancient mycelium'
